newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay sugar prices up on fresh consumer interest.
newsitem.headline: Bombay sugar prices up on fresh consumer interest.

text.p: Bombay sugar prices on Tuesday rose on fresh consumer interest and limited inflows, dealers said.
"Reports that federal authorities have reduced the free sale quota for Maharashtra state for July by more than 450,000 quintals also triggered speculative buying," one broker said.

In ready delivery sugar S-30 rose by 10/14 rupees to 1,472/1,500 rupees per quintal while M-30 rose by 10/15 rupees to 1,490/1,525 rupees per quintal. Sugar mill delivery too rose on renewed outstation buying.

In the mill delivery sugar S-30 rose by 5/10 rupees to 1,420/1,430 rupees per quintal while M-30 rose by 5/10 rupees to 1,435/1,455 rupees per quintal. Overall market sentiment was firm at the close of the session.
